reasons: Classification is correct: Arizona governing law is outside the accepted set (NY/DE/CA/England & Wales), so the clause fails both the preferred and fallback positions, and the dispute forum is mandatory administered arbitration rather than the courts the playbook requires — a genuine deviation, not an acceptable fallback.
Redline in p0043 makes the minimal substantive change (Arizona -> State of New York) and adds the exclusive New York County court venue, leaving severability and conflict-of-laws language intact.

The larger rewrite of p0056 (changed-character ratio 0.868) is justified: the rule requires courts rather than arbitration, so the arbitration referral and the now-redundant award-confirmation sentence must be replaced; the resulting sentence still reads coherently from the '(b) ... (collectively the "Disputes")' fragment.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, states what changed and why, and offers the Delaware/California/England-and-Wales fallback.
No double-flagging or counterparty-benefit issue; medium severity is appropriate since the arbitration is domestically administered and Arizona is not a foreign home forum (not walk-away).
